x-lid.version_rule: MINOR: additive; no existing schema or entity file is changed
changes_from_as_received: cycle status enum is TRACED / PROPOSED / UNKNOWN; PROPOSED_UNSOURCED retired; fields unsourced and legacy_status added
0.2.0: cycle field phases added (ordered list, optional)

title: cycle registry file
description: A standalone registry of named cycles (registry/cycles.json), following the registry file convention of registry/sources.json and registry/assumptions.json ({note, <plural>}). Cycles are cycles of whatever is in context; every cycle is named; cycles nest, and the nesting invariant parent.period_s > child.period_s is enforced by reference/trace_check.py (NESTING_VIOLATION), not by this schema, because it compares values across items. The log10 of the period ratio is the timescale-separation ladder. The cycle item definition is byte-identical to definitions.cycle in reference_trace.schema.json; the validation suite asserts equality so the two cannot drift silently.

cycle.description: One named cycle. Byte-identical to definitions.cycle in cycle_registry.schema.json; the validation suite asserts the two definitions stay equal so they cannot drift silently. Nesting invariant: when both parent and child carry period_s, parent.period_s / child.period_s must be > 1 (trace_check.py NESTING_VIOLATION); the log10 of that ratio is the timescale-separation ladder. Expressible only per-pair, so it is checker-enforced, not schema-enforced. Adopted copy: status vocabulary shared with nodes; unsourced is a flag.

name.description: Every cycle is named (owner rule, ledger v0.3): sleep, circadian, seasonal, compute. A bare word 'cycle' is not a name.

kind.description: keeps oscillation, developmental window, production cycle and a transient inside a cycle apart without ranking them. Extending this enum is backward compatible; removing a value is not.

period_s.description: Period in seconds. Null or absent when unsourced (trace_check.py CYCLE_NO_PERIOD is informational, not an error).

period_text.description: The period as recorded, with uncertainty and sample size where known (e.g. '≈230 Hz (229.8 ± 11.0 Hz, n=4, hovering)').

context.description: The conditions the period holds under: a cycle is a cycle of whatever is in context.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing slower cycle, or null/absent at the top of the nesting. Must name an existing cycle (trace_check.py CYCLE_DANGLING_PARENT).

source.description: Source strings or URLs. Null marks an explicitly unsourced cycle (observed on PROPOSED_UNSOURCED); when present the list is non-empty. TRACED requires a non-empty list (if/then below; trace_check.py CYCLE_NO_SOURCE).

status.description: One vocabulary shared with nodes. PROPOSED_UNSOURCED is retired (registry/DECLARED.json, amendment 'process form + Kimi schemas'): it is written PROPOSED with unsourced true. TRACED requires source.

unsourced.description: True when no source describes the item. Only with status PROPOSED. Replaces the retired status PROPOSED_UNSOURCED.

legacy_status.description: The status as first recorded, when it was mapped (for example PROPOSED_UNSOURCED).

phases.description: The cycle's phases in order, earliest first. Optional. Used to decide whether a phase is completed relative to phase_now. For a repeating cycle the order reads one turn.

note.description: Registry-level note, same role as 'note' in registry/sources.json.

status.description: Registry lifecycle, same vocabulary as the reference trace record.

baseline_commit.description: Git commit hash of the repository baseline, when the registry was extracted from a traced baseline. 40 hex chars for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256.

cycles.description: All named cycles, fastest to slowest. Id uniqueness and the parent-period nesting invariant are checker-enforced.
